description_en: Queries the list of multi-account management accounts
description_zh: 获取多账号管控账号列表
name: ListAccountsInResourceDirectory

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts (Alibaba Cloud account) in the resource folder.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

Accounts.description_en: The list of member accounts in the resource directory
Accounts.description_zh: 资源目录下成员账号列表

items.description_en: The details of the account information

AccountId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member

BuySas.description_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated and can be ignored
BuySas.description_zh: 该参数已废弃，无需关注

BuySasNew.description_en:
Indicates whether a Security Center subscription instance is purchased. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
BuySasNew.description_zh:
是否购买云安全中心包年包月实例。取值：
true：是
false：否

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
0: Subscription
1: Pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh:
包年包月，取值：
0：预付费
1：按量付费

FolderId.description_en: The ID of the folder in the resource directory to which the account belongs
FolderId.description_zh: 所在资源目录的资源夹ID

InstanceBuyType.description_en:
The purchase type of the instance. Valid values:
0: Self-purchased
1: Allocated by multi-account
InstanceBuyType.description_zh:
实例购买类型。取值：
0：自购
1：多账号分配

IsMaAccount.description_en:
Indicates whether the account is the management account of the resource directory. Valid values:

yes: Yes.

no: No
IsMaAccount.description_zh:
是否是资源目录的管理员账号。

yes：是

no：否

IsMarked.description_en: Indicates whether the account is marked as followed

IsSasDaAccount.description_en:
Indicates whether the account is a delegated administrator account for Security Center. Valid values:

yes: Yes.

no: No
IsSasDaAccount.description_zh:
是否是云安全中心的委派管理员账号。

yes：是

no：否

IsSiemControlAccount.description_en:
Indicates whether the account is a management account for Cloud Threat Detection and Response (CTDR). Valid values:

yes: Yes.

no: No
IsSiemControlAccount.description_zh:
是否属于威胁分析与响应的管控账号。

yes：是

no：否

IsSiemDaAccount.description_en:
Indicates whether the account is a delegated administrator account for Cloud Threat Detection and Response (CTDR). Valid values:

yes: Yes.

no: No
IsSiemDaAccount.description_zh:
是否属于威胁分析与响应的委派管理员账号。

yes：是

no：否

PostBasicService.description_en:
The status of the pay-as-you-go module switch. Valid values:
0: Disabled
1: Enabled
PostBasicService.description_zh:
后付费模块开关。取值：
0：关
1：开

PostPayModuleSwitch.description_en:
The status of the pay-as-you-go module switch, in JSON string format. Valid values:
Key:
VUL: Vulnerability fixing module
CSPM: Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) module
AGENTLESS: Agentless detection module
SERVERLESS: Serverless asset module
CTDR: Cloud Threat Detection and Response (CTDR) module
RASP: Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) module
SDK: Malicious file detection SDK module
POST_HOST: Host and container security module
Value: 0 indicates disabled. 1 indicates enabled
PostPayModuleSwitch.description_zh:
按量付费模块开关状态，格式为JsonString，取值：
Key：
VUL：漏洞修复模块
CSPM：云安全态势管理模块
AGENTLESS：无代理检测模块
SERVERLESS：Serverless资产模块
CTDR：威胁分析与响应模块
RASP：应用防护模块
SDK：恶意文件检测SDK模块
POST_HOST：主机及容器安全模块
Value：0表示关闭，1表示开启

SasVersion.description_en:
The purchased edition of Security Center. Valid values:

0 or 1: Free Edition
2 or 3: Enterprise Edition  
5: Premium Edition  
6: Anti-virus Edition 
7: Ultimate Edition
SasVersion.description_zh:
已购买的云安全中心版本。 取值：

0或1：免费版
2或3：企业版  
5：高级版  
6：防病毒版 
7：旗舰版

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
